title: 第5章 小成！
content_zh:
他坐在修炼场内，百虎图随意的放在膝盖之上，整个人都无比的放松，眼睛一眨不眨的盯着那百虎图。

条虎类妖兽仿佛复活了一样，在他的面前腾跃，是最为癫狂之态。

看着看着，沉凝的秦政体内有一股狂暴的气息孕育而出，斗虎势与那气势相联通，讲究的就是一种势，而今他观百虎图有所悟，整个人都好似推到了一个爆发的边缘。

哪怕是虎类妖兽本身有强弱之分，有些不如其他的妖兽，却仍旧有着那种百兽之王的气势，战死也绝不服输。

收起百虎图，他站起身，两脚牢牢站稳，双手向前探出，好似百虎图中人立起来的独角妖虎。

斗虎势观虎之猛，而非一定要模仿虎的一切。

这是以人为本，以虎之猛为辅的一种武技，根据人与虎两种形态来确定斗虎势的强弱。

秦政深吸一口气，按照斗虎势的方式，气入五脏六腑，渗透肺部，随着吸气，肺部内有气增多，气浪流动厉害，使得那吸气也传出很强的声响。

呼出一口气，四周的空气受到牵引一般，滚滚而聚他的口鼻处，形成茫茫白气，传出低沉的虎啸声。

“修炼达到气武境之后产生真元，这真元是夺取天地造化之精气，淬炼己身，以此向天夺命，这是武道之本。”

“武道终极便是寿命延长，乃至长生。”

“这斗虎势是夺这天地精华，熔炼胸腹之内，淬炼己身，更能孕育力量，以虎之猛，人之体，迸发出无穷杀机。”

此修炼之法与武道修行炼体密切相连。

将所有的修炼之妙在脑海中过滤一遍，用心体会，双目盯着百虎图中独角妖虎呈现出来的惨烈狂野，秦政双臂之内有着滚滚而来的气浪化作长河一般，双目迸**光，浑身的肌肉绷紧，充满了爆炸性的力量，口中陡然发出一声虎啸，对着虚空猛烈的轰出双拳，那一刻，脚下地面似有裂开迹象，他也如同虎王下山一般猛然扑杀出去。

地面上两块足有半人大小坚硬无比的青石被他双手打碎，无数的碎石带着劲力四处呼啸飞射，更有被拍成粉末的石末漫天飞舞。

这只是力武境，没有达到气武境修出武道根本的真元，是吸一口气用的天地精气而已，就达到如斯地步，若是达到气武境之后，再应用斗虎势，威力之强，以秦政在东海王府所见到的一切来说，怕是真的没有武技可与之相比啊。

吸一口气，这股气始终不泄，按照斗虎势之法在流动着，他也不断地在这修炼之地，不断地演练着脑海中看到的百虎图中百虎的姿态动作。

两者结合，刚猛之余，更有柔韧，是为斗虎势。

秦政就似那下山的猛虎，腾挪跳跃，双手连连挥出，时而虎爪，时而拳头，根本不需要刻意的完全模仿虎之态，取其优点即可。

越炼越是狂野，他的血液沸腾，仿佛也要受到牵引，化作猛虎。

一通斗虎势施展完毕，秦政毫无汗渍，反而精神奕奕，呼吸均匀。

“我仅仅是看了百虎图，就能有如此威势，若是达到大完满的观神武大陆一切虎之态，岂非一拳可破苍穹。”

这一拳按照斗虎势的那种呼吸，一呼一吸，夺取天地精华淬炼己身，浑然一拳，完全就是肉身的力量，便将那一株足有海碗口粗细的海青杉树给打断了。

“按照斗虎势之法呼吸运用纯粹的肉身力量，堪称变态中的极品了。”

不断地演练着斗虎势，伴随着修炼，他的力量也是越来越强，比之前的修炼更加的迅猛许多。

斗虎势的修炼不仅仅是武技的修炼，更是武道的修行。

不断地演练着百虎图中各类的妖兽姿态，进而在不断演练过程中，对于气势的掌握，发力的运用，去芜存菁，这就是斗虎势的奥妙所在，每个人修炼都不同，只需要根据自己的身材，气质，根骨，感觉去演练属于自己的斗虎势就行了。

不断重复，不断演练，越来越简单。

打着打着，秦政就有一种豁然开朗之感，好似全身都通透一般，百虎图内妖虎的举动归结为一吼，一动，一扑，一跃，俱都是充斥着无尽的虎王气势的。

越是如此，越是兴奋，秦政对斗虎势的认识就越深一层。

秦政扬天发出一声虎啸，颇有虎啸山林我为王的虎王之态。

秦政腾跃而起，那一刻他就如同一头妖虎之王般，震动的空气都猛烈地颤抖起来，对着前方一株海碗口粗细的海青杉树打去。

海青杉树轰然爆炸，化作漫天的碎屑。

先前一拳只是打断，而今却是打碎。

秦政不由得纵声大笑起来，他确定斗虎势已经有所小成。

接下来他在这玉莲院内，与外界隔绝般，疯狂地修炼着，以斗虎势的修炼，不断地提升自己的实力，争取早日再做突破。

直至有人到访，才打断秦政的修炼。

来人正是小王爷秦逸的贴身家奴秦宏。

跟随秦宏前来的还有四人，俱都是彪形大汉。

“小王爷说是给你三天时间，却等了你十天之久，也算是给你面子了，秦政，带着铁盒子跪献给小王爷吧。”秦宏大刺刺的站在秦政面前，双手抱胸，身后四个彪形大汉一字排开，气势很足。

秦政哼道：“铁盒子是老王爷留给我的，不可能交给任何人。”

秦宏一听，脸上顿时露出灿烂的笑容，“这样最好，你秦政仗着老王爷的宠爱，一向作威作福的，我们几个早就看不惯了，这次看小王爷怎么收拾你。”

“他要对我不利，尽管来便是。”秦政冷冷的道。

“怕了？不想去？哈哈，你秦政也有怕的时候。”秦宏大笑道，“可你必须得去。”

他话音一落，身后四个彪形大汉就向前一步，大有要动手的态势。

这四个大汉俱都是力武境高级，远不是秦政一个力武境初级能够抗衡的。

就听秦宏道：“你最好不要反抗，要是被打断胳膊打断腿的可怨不得我们，。”

秦政沉声道，“你们要我去哪里。”

秦政怔了一下，下意识的摸摸鼻尖，嘴角不经意的流露出一丝笑意，虎园可是妖虎聚集区，当即迈步向前走去，“我跟你们去。”
content_en:
He was sitting in the training ground, with the Hundred Tigers Diagram casually placed on his knees. His whole body was extremely relaxed, and his eyes were staring at the Hundred Tigers Diagram without blinking.

The tiger monster seemed to be resurrected, prancing in front of him in the most crazy state.

As he watched, a violent aura emerged from Chen Ning's body. The Tiger Fighting Momentum was connected with that aura. It was about a kind of momentum. Now that he had gained enlightenment by looking at the Hundred Tigers Picture, his whole body seemed to be pushed to the edge of an explosion.

Even though the tiger monsters themselves have strengths and weaknesses, and some are not as good as other monsters, they still have the aura of the king of beasts and will never admit defeat even if they die in battle.

Putting away the Hundred Tigers Picture, he stood up, his feet firmly planted, and his hands stretched forward, like the one-horned demon tiger standing upright in the Hundred Tigers Picture.

When fighting a tiger, you should see how ferocious the tiger is, but not necessarily imitate everything about the tiger.

This is a martial art that is human-oriented and supplemented by the fierceness of the tiger. The strength of the tiger fight is determined based on the two forms of human and tiger.

Qin Zheng took a deep breath. According to the tiger fighting posture, the air entered the internal organs and penetrated into the lungs. As he inhaled, the air in the lungs increased, and the air waves flowed fiercely, making the inhalation make a strong sound.

Exhaling a breath, the surrounding air seemed to be pulled, and rolled into his mouth and nose, forming a vast white air, and a low tiger roar came out.

"After you reach the Qi Martial Realm through cultivation, you will generate true essence. This true essence is to seize the essence of creation from the heaven and earth, temper your body, and use it to take your life from the sky. This is the foundation of martial arts."

"The ultimate in martial arts is to extend your lifespan and even live forever."

"This tiger fight is to seize the essence of the world, smelt the chest and abdomen, temper the body, and breed strength. With the fierceness of the tiger, the human body bursts out with endless murderous intent."

This method of cultivation is closely connected with martial arts practice and physical training.

Filtering all the wonders of cultivation in his mind and experiencing it with his heart, he stared at the brutal and wild one-horned demon tiger in the Hundred Tigers Picture. Qin Zheng's arms were filled with rolling air waves that turned into long rivers, and his eyes burst with light.The muscles all over his body were tense and full of explosive power. He suddenly let out a tiger's roar and punched the void violently. At that moment, the ground under his feet seemed to be cracking, and he rushed out like a tiger king coming down the mountain.

Two extremely hard bluestones on the ground that were half the size of a man were smashed into pieces by his hands. Countless gravels roared and flew in all directions with great force, and even the powdered stones were flying all over the sky.

This is only the Liwu realm. It has not reached the Qiwu realm to cultivate the fundamental essence of martial arts. It is just the essence of heaven and earth used to inhale, and it has reached such a point. If after reaching the Qiwu realm, one can use the fighting tiger posture. The power is so strong. Based on what Qin Zheng saw in the East China Sea Palace, there is really no martial arts that can compare with it.

Taking a breath, this energy never leaked, flowing according to the method of fighting tigers. He also continued to practice the postures and movements of the hundreds of tigers in the Hundred Tigers Picture in his mind in this training place.

The combination of the two is not only strong but also flexible, it is a tiger-fighting force.

Qin Zheng is like the tiger coming down the mountain, leaping and jumping, swinging his hands continuously, sometimes with tiger claws, sometimes with fists. There is no need to deliberately imitate the tiger's attitude completely, just take the advantages.

The more he practiced, the wilder he became. His blood boiled, as if he was being pulled and turned into a tiger.

After performing the Tiger Fighting Technique, Qin Zheng showed no trace of sweat. Instead, he was full of energy and breathing evenly.

"I can have such power just by looking at the Hundred Tigers Picture. If I could reach the perfect state of observing all the tigers in the Shenwu Continent, I would be able to break the sky with one punch."

This punch was based on the breathing of the fighting tiger posture, exhaling and inhaling, seizing the essence of the world and tempering the body. With one punch, it was completely the power of the physical body, and it interrupted the sea green cedar tree that was as thick as the mouth of the sea bowl.

"Using pure physical power by breathing according to the tiger fighting posture method is the best among perversions."

He continued to practice the tiger fighting posture, and as he practiced, his strength became stronger and stronger, much faster than before.

The practice of fighting tiger posture is not only the practice of martial arts, but also the practice of martial arts.

Continuously practice the postures of various monsters in the Hundred Tigers Picture, and in the process of continuous practice, master the momentum, use force, eliminate the bad and retain the good. This is the secret of the tiger fighting posture. Everyone's practice is different. You only need to practice your own tiger fighting posture according to your body, temperament, bones and feelings.

Keep repeating and practicing, and it becomes easier and simpler.

As he slapped, Qin Zheng felt a sudden sense of enlightenment, as if his whole body was transparent. The actions of the demon tiger in the Hundred Tigers Picture can be summed up as a roar, a move, a pounce, and a leap, all of which are filled with endless momentum of the Tiger King.

The more this happens, the more excited he is, the deeper Qin Zheng's understanding of the potential of tiger fighting becomes.

Qin Zhengyang let out a tiger's roar, quite like a tiger roaring like a tiger roaring in the forest.

Qin Zheng jumped up. At that moment, he was like a demon tiger king. The shaking air trembled violently, and he hit a sea cedar tree in front of him that was as thick as the mouth of a sea bowl.

The sea green cedar tree exploded and turned into debris all over the sky.

Previously, the punch only interrupted, but now it shattered.

Qin Zheng couldn't help but burst into laughter. He was sure that the tiger fight had been somewhat successful.

Next, he practiced crazily in the Jade Lotus Courtyard, as if isolated from the outside world, practicing like a tiger, constantly improving his strength, and striving to make a breakthrough as soon as possible.

It wasn't until someone came to interrupt Qin Zheng's practice.

The person who came was none other than Qin Hong, the personal servant of the young prince Qin Yi.

There were four more people who followed Qin Hong, all of them were tall and handsome men.

"The young prince said he would give you three days, but he has waited for you for ten days. This is considered to be a favor to you. Qin Zheng, please kneel down and present it to the young prince with the iron box." Qin Hong stood in front of Qin Zheng with his arms crossed, and four sturdy men lined up behind him, showing great momentum.

Qin Zheng hummed: "The iron box was left to me by the old prince and cannot be given to anyone."

When Qin Hong heard this, a bright smile suddenly appeared on his face, "This is best. You, Qin Zheng, rely on the old prince's favor and have always been domineering. We have long been disgusted with it. Let's see how the young prince will deal with you this time."

"If he wants to harm me, just come." Qin Zheng said coldly.

"Are you scared? Don't want to go? Haha, you Qin Zheng are also scared sometimes." Qin Hong laughed, "But you have to go."

As soon as he finished speaking, the four sturdy men behind him took a step forward, almost ready to take action.

These four powerful men are all at high levels in the Liwu Realm, and they are far beyond what Qin Zheng, a junior in the Liwu Realm, can contend with.

Qin Hong said: "You'd better not resist. If your arms and legs are broken, you can't blame us."

Qin Zheng said in a deep voice, "Where do you want me to go?"

Qin Zheng was startled for a moment, then subconsciously touched the tip of his nose, with a smile inadvertently showing at the corner of his mouth. Huyuan was a gathering place for monster tigers, so he immediately stepped forward and said, "I'll go with you."
